process: pp -> H2 H2 -> b b b b

ctau_efficiency_summary.efficiency_trend: Efficiency starts near zero at 0.3 mm (sel=0), rises sharply to 0.0157 at 4.33 mm, peaks at 0.0186 for 10-30 mm, and drops to 0.0069 at 300 mm due to decays outside the inner detector tracking volume.

key_findings.efficiency_dependence: Trackless selection efficiency is strongly non-monotonic with ctau, peaking in the 10-30 mm window.
key_findings.trilinear_coupling_impact: Production cross section scales quadratically with g_hH2H2; increasing g from 63.6 GeV to 205.1 GeV enhances yield by 10.4x, reaching the S95 = 3 threshold at baseline ctau and BR.
key_findings.branching_ratio_suppression: Yield scales as BR(H2->bb)^2; reducing BR from 1.0 to 0.1 suppresses signal yield by a factor of 100.
key_findings.experimentally_relevant_region: Effective combinations with g >= 150 GeV, ctau in 3-100 mm, and BR >= 0.5 reach N_expected >= 1, while g >= 205 GeV reaches or exceeds the official ATLAS S95 = 3 event threshold.
